raw.note: real MNIST via idx; NO PCA; full 784-d; per-sample L2 normalized for amplitude encoding

pca.note: real MNIST via idx; balanced sampling; PCA(10) fit on train only; scaled to [-pi, pi]

pca_full.note: real MNIST via idx; balanced sampling; PCA(40) fit on train only; scaled to [-pi, pi]

img.note: real MNIST via idx; full 28x28 images; pixels /255

caveat: 探针是冻结特征 + 经典分类器的可分性上界，不是端到端训练结果；多可观测量会增加分类头参数量，mlp40 为等分类头预算的经典参照；振幅编码在真机上需要 O(2^n) 状态制备；n=5 未做多重比较校正。结论性数字均为 5 seed 均值 ± 标准差。
